login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with your email and password.
mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
recovery.title: Recovery code
recovery.description: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each code works only once.
enroll.title: Set up your second factor
enroll.description: Your account requires a second factor. Use an authenticator app (TOTP).
enroll.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code to register the authenticator app
enroll.manual: Can't scan it? Type this key manually.
enroll.recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
enroll.recovery.description: They are your last resort if you lose the app. Each one works once and will not be shown again.
enroll.recovery.file.warning: Keep this file in a safe place and do not share it. Each code works only once.
enroll.recovery.leave.title: Leave without saving your codes?
enroll.recovery.leave.description: If you leave now you will lose these recovery codes and they will not be shown again. Check “I have saved them” once you have stored them.
invitation.title: Accept invitation
invitation.missingToken: The invitation link is missing. Open it again from the email you received.
invitation.invalid.title: Invalid invitation
invitation.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. A long phrase beats a short password full of symbols.
strength.label: Password strength
strength.privacy: Checked in your browser; the password is never sent to any third party.
passwordChange.title: Change your password
passwordChange.description: Your initial password is single-use. Choose a new one before continuing.
passwordChange.newHelp: At least 12 characters, different from the current one. A long phrase is better than a short password with symbols.
passwordChange.currentIncorrect: The current password is not correct.
setup.title: Initial setup
setup.description: Create the first organization and its Root user. This link works only once: it stops working when you finish.
setup.organizationSlugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. For example: my-company.
setup.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. A long phrase beats a short password full of symbols.
setup.missingToken: The link has no token. Use the full link prepared by whoever deploys the platform.
setup.closed.title: Invalid link
setup.closed.description: This link is not valid or the initial setup has already been completed.
setup.codes.title: Save the emergency codes
setup.codes.description: Each line starts with the letter of its custodian (A or B). Give each group to a different person. They are shown only now.
setup.done.title: Setup complete
setup.done.description: The organization and the Root user are ready. Sign in with the email and password you just set.
